main_text.l: Coruini generis funt graculi seu mo-nedulæ,sic dicti quod gregatim volent,vel à sono oris, quasi garruli, funt enim clamoli: vel ut alii putant à gerendo,quod jacta femi-na segetum legant, monedulæ vero à mone-ta, quasi monetulæ, solis enim his miram auri, argentique furacitatem inesse tradit Plinius lib.10. cap.29. Vnde Cicer. in orat. pro Flacc. non plus aurum tibi, quam mo-nedulæ committebatur. Infitionis tene-raque inferendi emplaftrationis causam & inuentionem monedulis tribui, condenti-bus femina in cauernarum thefauros, idem lib.17.capit.13.teftis eft. Qu busdam in locis habentur in cibatu, & tonstrinæ ibidem eas educant in caveis, docentque humanas exprimere voces. Mira autem his in vino lasciuia, à cuius potu evadunt loquaciores. Quidam exiftimant mone-dulas, ut & picas comitiali morbo tentari, quoniam plerunque velut extinctæ ex arbo-rum tectorumq; culminibus decidere inter-ram conspiciuntur, ob eamq; causam à vul-go mensis etiam abdicantur.

Linguam reliquis animantibus habet latiorem, unde loquacissima & humanæ vocis magis æmula est. Expressior lo-quacitas certo generi picarum est, ait Plinius lib.10. cap.42. adamant verba quæ lo-quantur, nec discunt tantum, sed diligunt, medi

page.notes: Catchword "medi" read as printed; the word may be continued on the next page. Long s is transcribed as s throughout, so "fono", "feu", "folis", "inefle", "bufdam" and similar words are read as sono, seu, solis, inesse, busdam; the printed letter could be a real f in "furacitatem" and "bufdam" (Qu bufdam), which is uncertain. "Qu" in "Qu busdam" is abbreviated and may stand for quibusdam; the scan is faint here. The marginal notes "Mone-dula.", "Mone-dulæ vini avida." and "Pica." are read from the left margin; the first and second are placed beside the lines where they stand. The running head is read as "De Vita" from small capitals.
